therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: amyloid burden reduction and slowing of neurodegeneration
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline on the Integrated Alzheimer's Disease Rating Scale (iADRS) at Week 76

results.effect_size: LS Mean difference 2.92 (overall population); 3.25 (intermediate tau population) on iADRS scale
results.target_engagement_evidence: Amyloid PET showed -87.03 centiloid change from baseline in donanemab vs -0.67 in placebo (difference -86.37 CL, p<0.0001)
biomarker_changes: Amyloid PET: donanemab -87.03 centiloids vs placebo -0.67 centiloids at Week 76
Tau PET (flortaucipir SUVR): donanemab +0.0401 vs placebo +0.0442 (difference -0.0041, p=0.4522, not significant)
Bilateral hippocampus volume: donanemab -0.20 cm3 vs placebo -0.22 cm3 (difference +0.02, p=0.002)
Bilateral whole brain volume: donanemab -27.46 cm3 vs placebo -20.79 cm3 (difference -6.66, p<0.001)
Bilateral ventricles volume: donanemab +10.07 cm3 vs placebo +7.05 cm3 (difference +3.02, p<0.001)
Anti-donanemab antibodies detected in 693/853 donanemab participants vs 48/874 placebo participants
Average serum concentration at steady state (Week 16-20): 63 micrograms/mL (geometric mean)
subgroup_findings: Intermediate (low-medium) tau population iADRS: donanemab -6.02 vs placebo -9.27 (difference 3.25, p<0.001)
Overall population iADRS: donanemab -10.19 vs placebo -13.11 (difference 2.92, p<0.001)
Bilateral hippocampus volume change: donanemab -0.20 vs placebo -0.22 cm3 (p=0.002)
Bilateral whole brain volume change: donanemab -27.46 vs placebo -20.79 cm3 (p<0.001)
Bilateral ventricles volume change: donanemab +10.07 vs placebo +7.05 cm3 (p<0.001)
safety_signals: Serious cardiac adverse events observed including acute myocardial infarction (5 donanemab vs 0 placebo)
Greater whole brain volume loss and ventricular enlargement in donanemab arm vs placebo, consistent with ARIA-related changes
High rate of anti-drug antibody formation in donanemab arm (693/853)
